decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight sits close to the firm's core lighting knowledge, so it can interpret results and refine the product, and its own page through 2023-2024 signals sustained commitment.
The LED ceiling luminaire builds directly on established competencies and has been consistently featured for two years, so the firm can assimilate feedback and keep improving it.
The flexible LED spotlight is close to the firm's existing offer and has a dedicated page, so related knowledge supports learning from early results despite the short time on the market.
The multi-outlet canopy extends the firm's modular system knowledge and complements its luminaires, so the firm can integrate and improve it.
The low-voltage canopy builds on the established modular system, though as a niche variant it carries somewhat higher risk of rationalisation.
The round glass track luminaires are close to the core offer, but being only mentioned rather than featured on a page of their own suggests weaker visibility and a higher chance of being pruned.
